thread:
anya: quick FYI — my docs PR for the Prompt Eviction & Graceful Trimming guide failed the snippets CI. Some sample outputs differ when context is truncated. Need coordination on examples and fallback wording.

frank: on it. which snippet failed? link?

anya: the SDK example that shows how to detect eviction changed outputs. CI diff shows message: "Context truncated -> user prompt clipped". PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/412

samir: looking into the harness. FYI there's a header the runtime emits when it evicts KV prefixes: `x-rw-eviction: partial` (we should not hard-code header name in docs though)

lina: can we add a small example showing `trim_prompt()` + fallback template? that helped one of our customers

frank: agree. I'll add a compact snippet and a note about quality regressions when trimming user instructions. Also propose a micro-eval section showing before/after.

docs-bot: snippet-lint results: 1 mismatch in 2/3 sample runs. See CI details: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/412

anya: thanks. samir, can you paste the minimal code we should show in the SDK?

samir: sure — suggest:

```
# pseudo-code
resp = client.generate(prompt=trim_prompt(user_input, max_tokens=2048))
if resp.headers.get("x-rw-eviction") == "partial":
    # backfill minimal instructions or fall back to shorter template
    resp = client.generate(prompt=short_instruct_template(user_input))
```

frank: nice. Let's also call out `retry_with_short_template` helper in the SDK examples.

lina: I'll own adding the examples + one tiny end-to-end test. I'll open a PR from `docs/prompt-eviction-examples`.

anya: perfect. frank, can you add the micro-eval YAML to the guide? just 3 inputs: long instruction, long chat, and a borderline case.

frank: on my list. @deploy-bot please hold snippet publish until docs PR merged.

deploy-bot: acknowledged — will queue snippet deploy after docs CI passes :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks team :pray: I'll update the runbook and link to error-ref entry once merged.

lina: ping me for review, I'll do it today :+1:
